output.answer: Coca-Cola's latest annual report is its Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, filed with the SEC on February 20, 2026 (accession no. 0001628280-26-010047). You can read it free on SEC EDGAR (sec.gov) or download it from Coca-Cola's investor relations site, investors.coca-colacompany.com, under Filings & Reports → Annual Filings (10-K). The company also posts its glossy annual publications (annual report and proxy statement) on the Annual Publications page of the same investor site.
caveats: The 10-K is the regulatory annual report; the shareholder-facing glossy annual report and the 2025 Annual Report PDF on the Annual Publications page were not directly opened in this research, so their exact links/availability should be confirmed on the investor site.
A 10-K/A amendment could supersede the original 10-K if Coca-Cola amends the filing; the Annual Filings (10-K) page lists 10-K/A in its filter, and none was observed for FY2025 as of 2026-11-11.
